code: write input bytes to temp .map file, call msLoadMap(filename, NULL, NULL)
note: Attacker-controlled input is written to a temporary .map file and passed to msLoadMap for parsing.

code: map = (mapObj*)msSmallCalloc(sizeof(mapObj), 1); if(loadMapInternal(map) != MS_SUCCESS) { msFreeMap(map); return NULL; }
note: msLoadMap allocates a mapObj and calls loadMapInternal; on failure it calls msFreeMap(map) which triggers the UAF.
When the parser encounters a PROJECTION token at map level, it calls loadProjection on map->projection.
The single projection argument string (e.g. '+proj=utm') is duplicated into p->args[0].

code: if( i == 1 && strstr(p->args[0],"+") != NULL ) { char *one_line_def = p->args[0]; p->args[0] = NULL; result = msLoadProjectionString( p, one_line_def ); free( one_line_def ); return result; }
note: Since i==1 and the arg contains '+', one_line_def points to the duplicated string, p->args[0] is set to NULL, and msLoadProjectionString is called.
msLoadProjectionString first calls msFreeProjectionExceptContext(p), which frees p->args (the array containing the NULL slot) and resets p->args=NULL, p->numargs=0.

code: projectionContext* ctx = p->proj_ctx; p->proj_ctx = NULL; msFreeProjection(p); p->proj_ctx = ctx;
note: Saves p->proj_ctx, sets it to NULL, calls msFreeProjection(p) which frees p->args and resets p->args=NULL, p->numargs=0, then restores p->proj_ctx.
Frees the original args array (with args[0]=NULL, numargs=0) and sets p->args=NULL, p->numargs=0.

code: if( value[0] == '+' ) { trimmed = msStrdup(value+1); ... p->args = msStringSplit(trimmed,'+', &p->numargs); free(trimmed); }
note: Processes the one_line_def string (e.g. '+proj=utm') by splitting on '+', allocating a new args array and setting p->numargs.
Calls msProcessProjection(p) with the newly allocated p->args array.
If p->args[0] is 'GEOGRAPHIC', msProcessProjection returns -1, causing msLoadProjectionString to return -1 and loadProjection to return -1.
loadProjection frees one_line_def (the original duplicated string) and returns -1, causing loadMapInternal to return MS_FAILURE.
loadMapInternal failed, so msLoadMap calls msFreeMap(map) to clean up the partially-initialized map.

msFreeMap calls msFreeProjection on map->projection and map->latlon. The projection object's p->args points to the new array from msStringSplit, and p->numargs is set, so msFreeProjection frees it correctly.

code: for(i=0; i<map->maxlayers; i++) { if(GET_LAYER(map, i) != NULL) { GET_LAYER(map, i)->map = NULL; if(freeLayer((GET_LAYER(map, i))) == MS_SUCCESS) free(GET_LAYER(map, i)); } }
note: msFreeMap iterates over layers and calls freeLayer on each. If a layer's projection was also processed by loadProjection with the same one-line-def path, its p->args may reference freed memory, leading to a heap-use-after-free READ 8 in msFreeProjection when freeLayer calls msFreeProjection(&(layer->projection)).
